content: Pool na Barnabaas ŋ Ikoñum
Wa Pool na Barnabaas nik ŋ Ikoñum wa nikohissa ɗaa : Ɓa aassa ŋ sinaagogaŋ Yawuut ca. Ɓa woyeeɗa na ɓooɓa ŋ woo kiŋ Kooh po Yawuut na nikaaɗi Yawuut laayiɗ kossa.
Waaye Yawuut ca kosaaɗiica tummba po ɓi nikɗi Yawuut raakka liiɓohaaɗ moɗaaɗi ŋ ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca.

Hondohɗi nak Pool na Barnabaas taalndiɗta nikka ŋ kur-taaha. Ɓa woyeeɗa woo kiŋ Kooh na hel daliɗ, laam ɓa oolkeen Heɗ ɓoo te a ndengɗeen ne woo ki teeɓoh baahohiŋ ɗe wa keeh. Ŋ ineem a onnda ɓa, ɓa tumeeɗa ɓi keemaan na ɓi in feyohiɗ.
Ɓooɓaŋ kur ka kerhiɗohɗi, ɓa paysukohha kanak : Ɓum lannga na Yawuut ca, ɓinooɓa lannga na Apootar ci.
Yawuut ca na nikaaɗi Yawuut ca hunnda na kilifaacaŋ ɓa, ɓa kooɗukka tum Pool na Barnabaas miskiɗ, ɓa tap ɓa atoh po ɓa ap ɓa.
Waaye wi ɓa inaha, ɓa kaɗta naafka ŋ kur-taah caŋ Likawni cii : Listar, Derbe na ina wil ca.
Ɓa woyeeɗa Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ ndaam.
Pool na Barnabaas ŋ Listar
Ŋ Listar, wa raakeen ƴaar minaaɗi tufuk nga ; a rimuk rimuk na ineem, a moosɗi tiindoh. A nikka ɓoofiɗ,
a sikɗukeeɗa woo kiŋ Pool. Pool iiƴca ɗe, hotta ne ƴaara raakiɗ kos ne a min wirɗu,
a woosa ɗe ŋ ɗafka ne : « Kurka, fu tufuk koc na kot ciŋ ɗa ! » Ƴaara kurukka japit, a tiindeeɗa.
Wa mboolnda hot ini Pool haɓiɗ, ɓa leehukka, ɓa woosa ŋ Likawni peɗmaŋ ɓa ne : « Hee, kooh ci ɓayiɗ mandohaaɗ ɓo', ca ruhsiɗ nga ɓoo. »
Ɓa teekka Barnabaas Sos, ɓa teekka Pool Hermes
, laam a yi ɓayohee woo ki.

Wa raakeen ŋ aasohaanaŋ kur ka ɗiska ɓa meeɗ ñaamkoh Sos. Seeƴkiɗoha ɓayya, ŋ fiki buntaanaŋ wa, ɓi naar inoh ɓekɗuuɗ tokkaah haɓɗohuuɗ pos. A waaɗta hun na mboolnda ne a seeƴkoh ca Barnabaas na Pool.
Wa Barnabaas na Pool kerah ineem, ɓa faarra kulɓaacaŋ ɓa sagu araami wa araam, ɓa faɗsukka mboolnda, ɓa woyeeɗa ŋ ɗafka ne :

« Ƴaaɓiŋ ngo, wa ye ɓek ɗu ŋ inii ? Ɓoo nam nik ɓo' njaay findiiɗu. Ɓoo hay ne ɓoo woo ɗu yegɗoh neɓiɗ ne ɗu faɗ in ci raakaaɗi njiriñ ci te ɗu wiiruk ŋ Koohi na pese, yi fer Eel ci na kehƴi na cookmi na in ci nik nga ca jen.
Wotɓa, a faɗeen cuuɓ ci jen, waa nu nga ɗah taambɗeeɗa waasiŋ ɗe.
Hondohɗi a taalndiɗta a teeɓeeɗa ɓa baah kiŋ ɗe : A ruhsiɗeeɗa toɓi ŋ eel ci wuu ɗu, a laaɓɗeeɗa yohon ci ŋ jamanooniŋ wa, a oneeɗa ɗu kañam, a riifɗeeɗa keeñ ciŋ ɗu na sum. »
Na woo ceem jen sah, wa yooɓeeɗi ŋ Barnabaas na Pool ne ɓa hondoh mboolnda seeƴuk wuu ɓa.
Wa ineem coot, ɓi Yawuut pulohha Añcos-Pisidi na Ikoñum, ɓa tummba po mboolnda lannga na ɓa. Ɓeem tapeeɗa Pool atoh ne ɓa ap ɗe, ƴutta ɓa faseeɗa ɗe po ɓa pulla kur ka, ɓa liiɓee ne a kaaniɗ.
Waaye wa taalubeeca hay ndeerra ɗe, Pool kurukka, a aassa kur ka. Ŋ Kooh-wiisiina, a hunnda na Barnabaas, ɓa kaɗta Derbe.
Pool na Barnabaas dokkiɗ Añcos
Pool na Barnabaas woosa Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ Derbe, ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ ndaam kossa, ɓa nikka taalube. Ŋ ineem, ɓa dokukka Listar, Ikoñum na Añcos-Pisidi,
ɓa ndengtineeɗa taalubeeca, ɓa ñaaheeɗa ɓa ne ɓa amb ndengiɗ kosi ɓa kos. Ɓa woosa ɓa ne : « Ɓoo joyiɗ taamb ŋ miskiɗ laayiɗ ɓoo han aas ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh. »
Jangu nu nik ɗah, Pool na Barnabaas tannda ɓi yakak nga ne ɓeem adgoha, ɓa kiimeeɗa Kooh, ɓa oreeɗa, ɓa faɗta ɓa ŋ yaah Heɗ ɓoo yi ɓa kose.
Ɓa pulohha ndeem, ɓa lahha ŋ ɗooƴ Pisidi, ɓa kaɗta Pamfili.
Ɓa yegɗohha woo kiŋ Kooh ŋ Perge, ƴutta ɓa kaɗta Attali.
Ŋ ndaam, ɓa aassa bato ne ɓa wiiruk Añcos, ɗiska kosiɗ ca wikohee ɓa Kooh ne a baahohaat ɓa ŋ pangki ɓa mitiɗ wii.
Wa Pool na Barnabaas ree Añcos, ɓa cohɗohha ɓi Janguuna, ɓa naandsukka ɓa in ci Kooh haɓiɗ taamboh nga ɓa jen, na findi a rangsiɗoh ɓooɓi nikɗi Yawuut waasiŋ kosi.
Ɓa tassa ŋ ndaam in maañiɗ na taalubeeci.

footnotes.text: Sos na Hermes : ca nikee kooh ŋ kooh ciŋ Gerek ci. Sos a yi adgohee kooh ciŋ ɓa. Hermes a yi meeɗ wik woos ci.
